people.name: Bethlehem
people.line: City of David's birth and Jesus' birth.

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Micah
people.line: A man from Ephraim who set up idolatrous worship.

translations.web: Micah said to him, “Where did you come from?” He said to him, “I am a Levite of Bethlehem Judah, and I am looking for a place to live.”
translations.bsb: “Where are you from?” Micah asked him. “I am a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah,” he replied, “and I am on my way to settle wherever I can find a place.”
translations.kjv: And Micah said unto him, Whence comest thou? And he said unto him, I am a Levite of Bethlehemjudah, and I go to sojourn where I may find
translations.asv: And Micah said unto him, Whence comest thou? And he said unto him, I am a Levite of Beth-lehem-judah, and I go to sojourn where I may find a place.
